item.title: Ko Restaurant returns with a revamped menu rooted in Hawaii's sugarcane plantation past
item.description: At Ko Restaurant, the Fairmont Kea Lani's fine dining establishment, dinner is more than a meal, it's a love letter to Hawaii's past.

item.title: From cane to glass: Ko's cocktails honor and innovate on Hawaii's Sugarcane Era
item.description: Ko Restaurant, inside Maui's luminous Fairmont Kea Lani, has launched a revamped menu that continues to honor Hawaii's sugarcane era, while also extending the theme to the glass, with its new bar program.

item.title: Federal agents in California don't have to visibly display their badges for now, judges say
item.description: Federal law enforcement officers in California don't have to visibly display their badges for now, a panel of appellate judges said.

item.title: San Mateo County installs purple Narcan boxes to help prevent overdose deaths: Here's how it works
item.description: San Mateo County is thinking "outside of the box" to reduce overdose deaths by installing purple boxes stocked with free Narcan, a medication that can reverse opioid overdoses, at transit hubs and public spaces.

item.title: Possible mumps exposure at 2 Berkeley schools, report says: Here's what to know
item.description: Two schools in Berkeley reportedly sent out a warning following a possible exposure to mumps on campus.

item.title: Over 70 people killed in attempt to capture Mexican cartel leader and violent aftermath
item.description: More than 70 people died in Mexico's attempt to capture the notorious leader of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel and the violent aftermath of his death.

item.title: US women's gold medal-winning team declines invitation from Trump to attend State of Union address
item.description: The U.S. women's hockey gold medal-winning team has politely declined an invitation from President Donald Trump to attend his State of the Union address on Tuesday.

item.title: Oakland teachers, school district resume labor talks; OUSD posts proposed $102M budget cuts
item.description: "We have not decided on a strike date. We will be providing the community with 48-72 hour notice of an impending strike," says teacher Olivia Udovic, who is one of 60 members on OEA's bargaining team.

item.title: Aisha Dee reveals all about her Hulu series 'Watching You'
item.description: "It affects you in a way that's really unexpected." Aisha Dee unpacks the drama in "Watching You." The psychological thriller is streaming now on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+.

item.title: Thrill for fans, headache for neighbors: Marina reacts to F1 street showcase
item.description: Tens of thousands packed Marina Boulevard to watch F1 cars speed down the waterfront. In the scramble for a better view, some spectators climbed trees, scaled walls and stood on private property, frustrating nearby residents.
